Klasse AbstractStrategyDecider

java.lang.Object
strategyDeciders.AbstractStrategyDecider
Bekannte direkte Unterklassen:
StrategyDeciderFINALSUBMISSION
public abstract class AbstractStrategyDecider extends Object
Abstract base class for all StrategyDeciders.

A StrategyDecider represents the highest decision-making level of the agent. It evaluates the current game state and combines multiple move categories into a final move for one game step.

It is uses information gained from the shared game state of the GameModel and methods of the StepAnalyzer as a foundation for the decision making in the decide() methods. Different StrategyDeciders can be implemented and tested due to modular design.

  • Methodendetails

    • decide

      public abstract String decide()
      Computes and returns the complete move for the current game step. Involves decision making for the composing of moves. The #updateBudget(Map, StepAnalyzer) method has to always be invoked in the very beginning of this method, otherwise, other methods can not work accordingly. In the next version of this agent, a template that guarantees this will be implemented!
      Gibt zurück:
      a valid move String representing the agent's decision for the current move

    • updateBudget

      protected static void updateBudget(Map<Integer,Integer> budget, StepAnalyzer sa)
      Updates the given budget map with the current number of Fernies of all nodes owned by the agent.

      The map gets cleared before updated.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget map that gets updated
      sa - the StepAnalyzer that has a list of the current owned nodes as an attribute
